units.source_text: 飞蛾是不是还活着呢？岛村站起身来，走了过去，隔着纱窗用手指弹了弹。

en.t: Was the moth still alive? Shimamura stood up, went over, and flicked it with his finger through the screen window.
It did not move at all.

units.source_text: 用拳头使劲敲打，它就像一片树叶似地飘然落下，半途又翩翩飞舞起来。

en.t: When he struck it hard with his fist, it drifted down like a leaf, then fluttered back into flight halfway through its fall.
